chart.title: Share of the population with access to clean fuels for cooking
chart.subtitle: Access to clean fuels or technologies such as natural gas, electricity, and clean cookstoves reduces exposure to indoor air pollutants, a leading cause of death in low-income households.
chart.citation: World Health Organization – Global Health Observatory (2026)
